overview: OnlySigned is a Web3 platform on the Internet Computer for trustless digital asset signing, certification, and trading. Creators, celebrities, institutions, and governments can sign digital assets as ICRC-7 NFTs — verifiable on-chain, impossible to fake — and sell them in a multi-currency open marketplace.
features: ICRC-7 NFT signed copies with full on-chain certificate verification
Open marketplace for signed copies and collections (ICP, ckBTC, ckUSDC, ckUSDT)
Username NFT system with admin minting and purchase offer workflow
Following system, contacts, private chat, and private asset sharing
Admin dashboard with audit logs, metrics, cycles balance, and role reassignment
User Explorer with advanced filtering and public profile pages
Privacy-first: all items default to private, encrypted user data
Signed copy download packages with embedded certificates and ICRC-7 metadata
